brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all six responsibility-chain requirements with no errors. RC1-RC6 are satisfied through active triage questioning, explicit medication safety warnings, workspace verification, specific follow-up domains (ENT/spine/facial wound), concrete action plans, and caregiver teach-back. High-order points HO1 and HO4 are completed: the doctor corrected caregiver misunderstandings about inpatient records vs. discharge orders, and navigated real-world constraints including transport difficulty and elderly patient needs. All five dimensions are at least good. Closure is valid with explicit contingency planning.

closure_assessment.explanation: The doctor provided a complete action plan: medication safety clarification, spine follow-up within 2-4 weeks, ENT follow-up per clinic schedule, and clear red-flag triggers for urgent care. Caregiver demonstrated understanding through teach-back. The episode is appropriately closed after action plan and receipt.
